queries.text: 2024 Microsoft's Recall feature became privacy scandal because initially designed screenshot user’s screen few seconds store data locally effectively acting photographic memory
controversy escalated security researchers demonstrated screenshots stored unencrypted plaintext within local SQLite database contradicting Microsoft’s claims encryption
In response to this backlash, which marked the AI PC era's and fundamentally changed how Recall operates . (2024)
revised version now opt-in default OFF rather enabled
